Orthodontist-formulated with fluoride, hydroxyapatite (nano-hydroxyapatite), vitamins D3 & K2, prebiotics, and clean ingredients, it removes 40% more plaque with patented expanding technology and convenient built-in threaders. Free from forever chemicals (PFAS) and petroleum-based waxes, in delicious flavors—chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, mint—for kids, teens, and adults.
header.superHtml:
Orthodontic patients, say hello to an ortho floss of heroic proportions. SuperMouth Ortho Floss uses patented expanding technology that clears away 40% more plaque than basic flosses** and includes a handy threader to make navigating the hardware in your mouth and cleaning between teeth a breeze!

Plus, to help prevent cavities and decalcification, our orthodontic floss is designed thicker and deposits a stronger blend of Hydroxamin® and fluoride to clean and protect every inch of the mouth. Whether you have braces, other orthodontic devices, bridges, or implants, this floss is uniquely designed to clean around brackets and wires, and even under bridges and implants where cleaning is often difficult.

  • Includes built-in floss threader
  • Expands between teeth
  • Uniquely designed to clean around braces, other orthodontic devices, bridges, and implants
  • Includes key ingredients: fluoride, nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins K2 and D3, and xylitol
  • No petroleum-based wax, no PFAS/PTFE (Teflon®)/PFOA/BPA; no artificial ingredients
  • Uses safe & natural beeswax

* contains nano-hydroxyapatite material, vitamins K2 and D3

** Genoa University clinical randomized controlled trial.

*** All SuperMouth products rank a 1 on the EWG scale.

FAQs
items.html:
What is ortho floss?
Ortho floss, also known as orthodontic floss or dental floss threaders, is a type of floss designed for people with braces or other orthodontic appliances. It consists of a stiff end that threads the floss around the wires to floss each tooth individually.
Why is ortho floss necessary?
Regular floss can't be used effectively with braces because the wire prevents you from flossing between teeth properly. Ortho floss allows you to thread the floss under the wire to clean each tooth surface and remove plaque and food debris.
Can you use regular floss with braces?
While standard floss can sometimes work, flossing with ortho floss is typically much easier to use with braces or other orthodontic appliances.
Can ortho floss be reused?
No, ortho floss should not be reused between flossing sessions. Orthodontic floss is meant for a single use only.
